description: This file initializes and starts an Express server for the EKYC Backend Service, binds it to a configurable host and port, logs startup information, and handles graceful shutdown on SIGTERM signal.

methods.name: app.listen
methods.description: Starts the Express server on specified host and port.

methods.name: process.on
methods.description: Registers an event handler for process signals, here used for SIGTERM to handle graceful shutdown.

methods.name: server.close
methods.description: Stops the server from accepting new connections and shuts down.

methods.name: console.log
methods.description: Logs messages to the console for startup and shutdown events.

methods.name: process.exit
methods.description: Exits the process with code 0 after cleanup.
